coverage_limits: Only the supplied allowed record and the 14 supplied law units are evaluated; no external search, project history, withheld final analysis, or historical final outcome is used.

The record preserves conflicting lower-stage findings: the ARC recorded failure to establish that petitioner No. 1 divested legal possession, while the ARCT later found exclusive occupation by petitioner No. 2 and divestment of physical and legal possession. These labels do not resolve that factual conflict.

The case narrative reports counsel's reliance on Krishnawati, Jagan Nath, and Vishwa Nath, but their full opinions are not supplied as candidate originals here; no additional rule is imported from citation familiarity.

The Delhi statutory reproductions are current snapshots with historical versions unverified. Their relevance is assessed from the supplied text only, and any retrospective use is subject to that temporal limitation.

The General Radio reported-Delhi unit is a reported-precedent paragraph rather than the independently acquired full Parasaram opinion; Telesound is a partial document and expressly reserves the section 14(1)(b) amalgamation issue.

The supplied record does not provide a written-consent instrument, a section 17 sub-tenancy notice, a bank/corporate amalgamation affecting this tenancy, or an authenticated historical statutory consolidation.
No preference is based on source length, packaging, dependency cost, citation familiarity, or a predicted eviction outcome.
